name: ref
description: Ref turns your chats into rich, visual plans your team can review and Codex can build from.

interface.longDescription:
Ref brings interactive, visual plan documents to your chats for you to review and agents to work from. Ask Ref for a plan and get a rich source of truth for your work with mockups, diagrams, HTML widgets, comment threads and task breakdowns for you to approve and share.

Ref is multiplayer; your team can edit, comment on, review and approve from the browser or within their own agent.

When you're ready to build, hand tasks back to Codex with a click; Ref updates the plan automatically as work moves forward or evolves.
capabilities: Rich, visual plans with mockups, diagrams and widgets
Review and approve plans before code
Share a plan with your team
defaultPrompt: Turn this chat into a visual plan with diagrams and tasks I can share with my team
Open this project's plan, show me what's done so far, and implement the next task
Look over my recent work and plan out a few small jobs worth doing today

positive.prompt: Use Ref to list my refs.
positive.expected_behavior: The reply names Sample: Launch checklist, Sample: Onboarding redesign and Sample: Q4 roadmap.

positive.description: Open a plan and read its task status
positive.prompt: Open my Sample: Launch checklist ref in Ref and tell me which task is done.
positive.expected_behavior: The Ref view shows the ref, and the reply names the one Task marked done.

positive.prompt: In Ref, comment on Sample: Onboarding redesign asking whether the diagram covers sign-up.
positive.expected_behavior: A new comment with that question appears on the ref.

positive.prompt: In Ref, add a "Risks" section with three bullets to Sample: Q4 roadmap.
positive.expected_behavior: The ref gains a Risks heading with three bullets; the rest is unchanged.

positive.description: Create a new plan and show it in the chat
positive.prompt: Use Ref to write a plan for adding dark mode to a web app, with three tasks I can review, then open it in Ref.
positive.expected_behavior: A new ref with three Tasks is created; the reply links it, and in ChatGPT the Ref view shows it.

negative.description: Too vague to act on. The assistant asks which ref and what to change, and edits nothing.
No such ref exists. The assistant says it found none and creates nothing.
negative.prompt: Open my Ref called Secret Project.

negative.description: Ref has no delete. The assistant says so and may archive the ref directly (reversible) or offer to archive; it does not delete.
negative.prompt: Delete my Sample: Q4 roadmap ref in Ref.
